_comment: Adhan recordings Noor may bundle. Every entry is a Wikimedia Commons file whose licence permits redistribution in an app. fetch_commons.py re-checks the live licence against 'licence' and refuses the file if it differs. Do not add recordings whose provenance is doubtful (for example commercial releases re-uploaded as 'public domain').

files.title: File:Adhan, Great Mosque of Mecca - Jan 21, 2013.webm
files.provenance: Recorded at al-Masjid al-Haram and published on YouTube under CC BY by the recordist (Seyfula Islam); licence confirmed by a Commons reviewer on 19 July 2018.

files.title: File:Maghrib Adhan at the Masjid al Haram, Mecca - 25 Feb, 2012.webm
files.provenance: Recorded at al-Masjid al-Haram before Maghrib and published on YouTube under CC BY by the recordist (3omar Faruq); licence confirmed by YouTubeReviewBot on 14 February 2020.

files.title: File:Eid al-Fitr Fajr azan at Malmö Mosque - 19 August 2012.webm
files.provenance: Fajr adhan published on YouTube under CC BY by the mosque itself (Islamic Center Malmö); licence confirmed by YouTubeReviewBot on 12 February 2020.

files.title: File:Adhan in Istanbul.webm
files.provenance: Field recording in Istanbul, own work of the uploader (Viceskeeni2), dedicated to the public domain.

files.title: File:Adhan in Shalqar mosque.webm
files.provenance: Field recording at the Matey Qoqanuly mosque, Shalqar, Kazakhstan; own work of the uploader (Esetok).

files.title: File:Llamada a oración Mezquita Hassan II.wav
files.provenance: Field recording beside the Hassan II Mosque, Casablanca; own work of the uploader (Fraguando).

files.title: File:Oración Al-Azzan.ogg
files.provenance: Recording of an evening adhan in Madinah; own work of the uploader (B9.), who released it into the public domain worldwide.

files.title: File:Islamic call to worship.oga
files.provenance: Own work of the uploader (Mahfoudou). Content must be checked after download: the description suggests it may be an explanation of the adhan rather than the adhan itself.
